title: Explainable multimodal deep learning predicts colorectal cancer prognosis
summary: A multimodal deep-learning model combining clinical variables with histopathological images was developed in 3381 patients with resected colorectal cancer from three centers. It performed more robustly than unimodal models across cohorts, and its risk groups remained independently prognostic in multivariable Cox regression. The abstract reports that adjuvant chemotherapy benefited high-risk but not low-risk stage III patients. It gives no numeric performance metrics.
ai_technology: Multimodal deep-learning framework integrating histopathology images and clinical variables for survival prediction

evidence.tested: Multi-cohort retrospective validation in three centers.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; no numeric metrics in the abstract; chemotherapy finding is a subgroup observation; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Model produces survival risk scores from slides and clinical data.
